$comment: Shared test vectors for the card parser/serialiser (PROTOCOL.md §2). Every platform's unit tests load this file. `parse` cases: input text → expected parsed card or null (not a card). `serialise` cases: card → exact expected text. `work` cases: PROTOCOL §10, the additive work extension — parsed by a second pass, so §2's own cases above are untouched by it. `private` cases: PROTOCOL §11, the private extension — the same second-pass shape as `work`; the two §2 parse cases naming §11 are the additivity claim run through §2's own loop. `atproto` cases: PROTOCOL §12, atproto sources — the card key and its two-way check in the same second-pass shape, plus the rules that put Bluesky posts into the §4.8 merge; the §2 parse case naming §12 is the additivity claim.

atproto.$comment: PROTOCOL §12 — atproto sources. `did`: normaliseDid(in). `parse`: atprotoDidOf(public card text) → DID or null (a second pass; §2 ignores the key, see the §12 case in `parse`). `serialise`: card (+ atprotoDid) → exact text, §12 line last. `recordKey`: linkRecordKey(node). `verify`: atprotoLinkVerified({cardText, node, did, record}) — record is getRecord's {uri, value} or null for RecordNotFound. `sortAt`: atprotoSortAt(post) in seconds, `feedTime`: atprotoFeedTime(entry). `tid`: tidMicros(rkey). `admit`: atprotoItem(entry) !== null. `merge`: scenarios run through the §4.8 merge — take everything, and when takeNext blocks on a source feed it that source's next page (Telegram: pushMessages; atproto: pushAtprotoPage with admit `tag` → tagSourceItem; `fail` → markExhausted; no pages left → markExhausted); expect is the emitted order, Telegram items as `<key>/<id>`, atproto items by at-uri. `crossPost`: crossPostTarget(post, nodeFeeds). `drop`: dropRefOf(post). `postKey`: safetyKey(link). `clientMetadata`: clientMetadataProblems(doc, fetchedFrom) → problem codes, [] is publishable.
